$comment: Machine-readable product terminology. Only English and Simplified Chinese are controlled here; other locales translate from these. Rationale lives in the private terminology spec and term cards. Avoid rules with status decided block newly added UI copy at pre-commit; status open only warns.

terms.meaning: Primary reading unit; imported, authored, extracted, or AI-derived.
Upstream, more complete topic such as an imported article.
Topic produced from a highlight, excerpt, cloze, split, or AI rewrite.
Selected text range or the act of marking it.
Text extracted from a topic; may become a derived topic.
Excerpt of any rectangular PDF page region; not a screenshot or OCR.
Creating an item by hiding part of a text.
Creating source topics from outside material.
Question, cloze, or front/back item that is reviewed; never a generic folder member.
Today's work view; not a container.
Aggregate view of every topic; not a container.
Generic word for library content when the object type varies (mixed selections, imports); prefer the specific object when it is known.
Reading and review flow; kept as the English name in Chinese UI.
Curated set of sources around one subject.
Formal name of the Virtual Folder feature; the Chinese name is a deliberate localization, not a literal translation.

avoid.reason: Internal tree structure; name the actual objects (topics, folders, items) instead.
Engineering word; name the actual object (topic, folder, item) or say material when the type varies.
Foliole is not a note app; only for external sources such as Obsidian notes.
Anki wording; say Item. Only for describing cards in external Anki or SuperMemo sources.
Rejected umbrella word; name the specific object or say material for mixed selections.
Only for import sources or external formats, not as a Foliole object.
